description: Scans a given scope (functional domain or explicit path) for known tech debt violations and produces a structured, read-only report. Never modifies files — output only. Trigger on: "analyse la dette de", "état des lieux de", "debt-radar sur", "montre la dette de", "scan la dette", "combien de violations dans", or any request to audit a domain or directory for technical debt without immediately fixing it.
